in_marathi.name: Maheshraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Mountain
in_marathi.long_meaning: Maheshraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Maheshraj is the name of Lord Shiva, who is considered the supreme deity in Hinduism. He is often referred to as the 'Lord of the Mountains' or 'Lord of the Universe' due to his association with Mount Kailash and the cosmos. In Hindu mythology, Maheshraj is known for his destructive and creative powers, and is the god of procreation, fertility, and auspiciousness.
